_: What to SAY to the generator for a UI ICON, one row per id. `tools/art/icon.mts` reads it and `portrait.mts <id> <png> 48 icons` puts the result in `src/render/generated-icons.ts`, which `skillIcon` and `categoryIcon` merge OVER their hand-drawn grids.
_how: An icon is read at 24-40px in a socket, so: ONE object, centred, filling the frame, hard silhouette, no scene and no ground. Asked at 64 and shipped at 48.
_inks: Lamplit stone, oiled timber and tarnished brass, with fire, frost, lightning and poison the ONLY saturated inks — so an element reads at socket size and everything else stays furniture.
how: A single ICON: ONE object centred and filling the frame, seen straight on, BOLD readable silhouette with a hard dark outline, chunky shapes and few colours, dramatic lighting off the object itself. NOT a scene, NOT a landscape, NOT a character, NOT a background, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT multiple objects. Transparent background.

icons.say: a heavy notched iron blade crossed with a worn leather grip, seen straight on, cold steel and dark iron.
a cracked violet crystal shard wreathed in a thin curl of arcane light, cold and glowing.
a closed iron sigil-ring set with one dull amber stone, still and unlit — a thing that is always ON rather than cast.
a pair of winged iron boot-spurs trailing a streak of pale motion, light and fast.

a heavy notched iron broadsword tilted diagonally, point to the upper right, with a broad curved streak of pale cold light sweeping behind its blade like the trail of a swing, nothing holding it, NOT a moon, NOT crossed swords.

a fireball in flight: a round blazing sphere of orange and gold flame with a searing white-hot core, tongues of fire streaming off it into a pointed trailing tail of flame and sparks, NOT a bonfire, NOT a candle, NOT a torch, NOT an explosion.
a narrow lance of orange fire flying point-first, a hot bright head with a thin trailing tail.
a jagged shard of pale blue ice flying point-first, sharp and cold with a frosted trailing tail.
a forked bolt of yellow-white lightning splitting into two branches, hard angular zigzags.

a ragged vertical curtain of thick glossy sickly-green slime hanging alone in empty space, long runnels sliding down it and fat drops breaking off its ragged bottom edge, glossy wet highlights on the goo, floating with nothing above it, nothing below it and nothing beside it.
a clenched iron gauntlet fist wrapped in a bright amber flare, a blow that has just landed.
a violet arcane rift torn open in the air, an oval slit of cold light with the edges peeling back.
a curving green arrow arcing up and over, with a puff of dust under its start.
